title: Pendant Battery Low Incident Trend
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:pendant device_id=* battery_low=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(battery_low="yes",1,0))) as matched by device_id
| eval a_low_battery_incident_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_low_battery_incident_pct
description: Measures the percentage of pendant battery intervals that end with a low-battery incident by device.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which device are helping or hurting pendant battery intervals.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a low-battery incident` on `care:pendant` events and summarize the hit rate by `device_id`.
visualization: Table of device with percentage of pendant battery intervals ending with a low-battery incident.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how often a low-battery incident happens for each device so you can see where pendant battery intervals go smoothly or get stuck.
